source_note: Representative bounded records derived from Worldshepherd project working documents; they are test/intake fixtures, not maturity upgrades.

records.model_scope: Programmable deposited aluminum meta-alloy platform concept and validation pathway
assumptions: Property and production claims require modeling and coupon validation
Partner interest is a commercialization milestone, not technical proof
failure_modes: composition/process window does not produce target microstructure
coupon properties fail to exceed selected baseline
process variability prevents repeatable zoning or deposition
hazard_controls: No manufacturing parameter is treated as qualified until coupon evidence exists
records.external_safe_statement: WS-AlTi M1-MSZ-Prime is presently an IP-stage programmable deposited aluminum meta-alloy platform concept; no coupon-validated property or production-performance claim is made by this record.

records.model_scope: Reconfigurable electromagnetic tiles using phase/amplitude/material tuning for bounded field shaping

governing_equations.name: complex tile response
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: phasor representation of a bounded harmonic electromagnetic tile state

governing_equations.expression: E(r) = sum_i A_i exp(j theta_i) G_i(r)
governing_equations.name: array field superposition
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: linear superposition model for a specified operating band and tile response

governing_equations.expression: rho c_p dT/dt = div(k grad(T)) + Q
governing_equations.name: thermal balance
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: continuum heat-transfer model with specified material properties and heat source

assumptions: Positive and negative coupling describe constructive/destructive field shaping rather than exotic force generation
Prime-indexed modes, when used, are a mathematical decomposition basis and not evidence of quantum behavior
Physical admissibility requires finite energy, bounded coupling, stable thermal response, and convergent state evolution
boundary_conditions: Operating band, geometry, material state, and incident-field conditions must be specified before simulation
failure_modes: mutual coupling invalidates simplified tile independence
loss and dispersion prevent target phase/amplitude state
sensor or calibration error produces false null/beam estimate
hazard_controls: No stealth, cloaking, cancellation, or RF-performance claim without measured hardware evidence
records.external_safe_statement: This record describes a concept-stage programmable electromagnetic boundary-condition architecture using established field, thermal, and control models; no measured Worldshepherd-specific RF, stealth, cloaking, or cancellation performance is claimed.
